items.stem: What is the benefit of 'state hoisting' in Compose?

options.text: It makes a composable stateless and reusable by passing value plus an onValueChange callback
options.rationale: Correct: hoisting gives callers control and improves testability/reuse.

options.text: It stores state permanently on disk
options.rationale: Hoisting concerns where state lives in the tree, not persistence.

options.text: It merges all composables into one

items.stem: Which practices improve a LazyColumn list in Compose? (Select TWO)

options.text: Provide stable keys for items so state and position survive updates
options.rationale: Correct: keys let Compose track items across changes.

options.text: Hoist item click handling up via callbacks
options.rationale: Correct: unidirectional flow keeps items reusable and testable.

options.text: Render all items eagerly like a plain Column
options.rationale: False; that defeats the laziness and hurts performance.

options.text: Mutate list state directly inside the item composable
options.rationale: False; events should flow up to the state owner.

items.explanation: Correct: keys let Compose track items across changes.; Correct: unidirectional flow keeps items reusable and testable.
